notes.title: 2018.7.13更新日志说明（版本0.9.7.3）
notes.content:
1.修改了角色基本攻击力
2.大追杀模式：
修改了大追杀模式下没有食物的BUG
3.商城：
增加了背部装饰：小天使，蝶之羽，天之羽翼，妖冶精翼，屎壳郎
该装饰会在“乱斗模式”“刀战模式”“射击模式”“炸弹模式”增加属性
我们将之前头饰的屎壳郎归纳到了背部装饰，并重新上架了头饰“开发者”
之前购买头饰“开发者”的玩家，可以免费获得该头饰

人物增加：香肠君，牙刷君，肥皂君，铲铲君，锤锤君，吸吸君

头饰增加:太空战士，驴哥，独角兽，草泥马

武器增加：枪系武器，作为攻击距离最长武器，攻击时会有硬直
武器打击特效增加，不同类型的武器有不一样的打击特效

notes.title: 2018.7.13更新日志说明
notes.content:
欢乐大乱斗：
“欢乐大乱斗”开放回归，我们对该模式做出了一些数值上的调整，使得从宝箱里面获得的技能更为强力
该乱斗模式下可以使用除近战武器外的攻击手段进行战斗，游戏中随机投放技能宝箱

大乱斗：
经过一个星期的测试，玩家反馈了诸多宝贵的建议，我们希望新手玩家与老玩家差距不要太大，所以移除了武器的属性，减少了死亡后掉落的血包数量
适当调整了人物属性加成
该乱斗模式下可以使用所有攻击手段进行战斗，通过击杀获得铜币，通过铜币可以自己选择较强的技能

三种新模式开放测试：

1.武器战
仅可以使用近战武器进行战斗，通过击杀获得铜币，每次复活可以选择一把武器
2.炸弹战
尽可以使用炸弹与核弹进行战斗，通过击杀获得铜币，使用铜币可以强化自己的炸弹类型
3.射击战
仅可以使用水枪进行战斗，通过击杀获得铜币，使用铜币可以强化自己的水枪类型
（开发者：我们希望获得这三种模式的反馈，从中选取玩家比较喜欢的战斗类型来决定组队模式的机制，我们还会继续完善这三种模式，添加独特的战斗机制）

其他：
新增各种UI图标
修改武器特效
修改了武器名称
新增身体与头发的颜色
排行榜新增武器专家排名
新增防具，防具会为近战模式增加角色初始护甲值，以及有小部分几率防御对方攻击（敌人攻击无伤害）
1.井盖
2.木盾
3.铁盾
4.钢盾
5.撒旦之盾

接下来我们会做
赌场系统
玩家可以用金币与赌博城伽马猫进行赌博，胜利有几率获取额外的金币与装备
组队模式
玩家会以组队形式进行对抗，或许是夺取资源，或许你们需要一门炸弹加农炮

notes.title: 2018.6.29 更新说明
notes.content:
新模式：“大追杀”上线后
经过与玩家们的交流，我们收集到了非常宝贵的反馈与建议
我们加入了新系统来完善“大追杀”模式
在游戏过程中遇到什么问题或者对游戏有建议的玩家们，欢迎加入我们的QQ社群
官方QQ社群：255434171
大追杀模式机制完善：
1.幸存者不再无限复活，被击杀后会成为子恶魔，不在获取生存分
2.生存者饥饿值为0后会持续掉血，最后会死亡。
3.加入最后生存分，在猎杀时间结束后，会给与当前生存者加入大量分数
4.生存人数越少，加分越高！
5.生存者被击杀完毕，便会开始下一轮游戏
子恶魔：幸存者被恶魔击杀后，灵魂会被恶魔收割，变成恶魔忠实的仆人。
子恶魔需要帮助恶魔寻找剩下的幸存者，赚的积分
1.子恶魔拥有恶魔“真视火焰”技能，冷却时间较长
2.子恶魔只能普通攻击（小拳拳捶你胸口）
3.找到幸存者后，可以呼叫恶魔来帮助你击杀幸存者
4.帮助恶魔找到幸存者，恶魔击杀后子恶魔加分


大追杀模式优化：
恶魔武器更换，增长了武器距离（先让生存者跑39米）
恶魔面具更换（酋长大面具）
恶魔出现提示声
幸存者剩余数提示声
武器击杀声
恶魔与生存者积分调整
灯光场景渲染优化
优化了敌我双方血条显示，敌人血条显示为红色，友方显示为蓝色

大追杀模式新地图：埋骨城堡
在古老的龙骨城堡里面，γ恶魔抓住了大量的幸存者，想用他们的灵魂复活古龙。
幸存者们团结一心，突破了牢笼！
γ幸存者与γ恶魔再一次在城堡里展开心惊动魄的追逐！

接下来我们大概在7月份制作完毕组队模式

notes.title: 2018.6.14 0.9.6.0Patch log
notes.content:
New mode: evil comes
In the new mode, players will take turns playing gamma-ray bursts and gamma-ray survivors who are possessed by demons
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Evil gamma-ray man:
1.Demons can get supplies from treasure boxes and food
2. Can obtain the location of the survivor without disguise
3.Listen carefully. Survivors make noises when they are hungry
4.Demons can also infiltrate a player's home in disguise
5.It will only be damaged by a nuclear bomb
6.Don't be interrupted and stiff
7. Score points for successfully killing camouflaged players, and NPCS
8.Getting killed by a nuclear bomb is punishable
Time is running out for the devil.
Find them...
None left!

Survivor gamma star:
1.The survivors were robbed of their attack power
2. Survivors can disguise themselves through various actions, imitating what the surrounding NPCS are doing
3. The hunger system is online: survivors need to eat to protect their camouflage ability, which will disappear once the hunger becomes excessive
4. The survivor will continue to withhold blood and the stomach will make a hungry sound
5. Survival will increase points, while approaching demons will double points
6.Kill the devil with a nuclear bomb and weaken him!!
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Steam Trading Cards：
The player can get the card card of change of type by the game time, synthesize the badge of our game!
And the background, the emojis are waiting

notes.title: 2018.6.4 Update log
notes.content:
Urgent update for serious bugs and some new things  
1) New map: the human living room
2. Fixed the big rural areas and small villages, where players could not move around properly.
3. The small cabinet model in the kitchen has been modified. It can't be entered from below now, but it can be entered through the cabinet door.
4. The BUG "enemy bomb cannot be found" in the new Chinese tutorial fixed.
5. Added hand grenades, ball bombs, and other special items to some of the maps.
6. Fall off world camera bug fixed.
7. "Serial killing" has been added.  
9. The problem of accidentally crashing the game while disarming a bomb fixed. 
10.The ball bomb now has an initial roll speed.

notes.title: 2018/6/1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Optimized the in air resurrection spawn points. You not spawn and fall faster to get right back in the action.
Optimized map terrain to make jumping onto objects easier.
Map box refresh points increased
Added special treasure boxes the have items like hand grenades that destroy laid bombs
Added graphic quality adjustment in settings.
Version of the custom meeting room is now available. You can also add a password and modify the room’s name.
Fixed falling through world bug when killed. 
First edition of combat statistics released.
In game store, system is now available.
Combat gold coin rewards released. Use gold coins to unlock/buy items in the in game store.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Next update includes:
New game mode
New maps
New skills
New items to purchase.
Badges are under review and will be available to players soon.

notes.title: Patch Notes for – 5/29/2018
notes.content:
New map added – The Kitchen
Optimized current maps
Basic player ranking system added
New Bomb Disposal Expert reward - Points awarded for removing enemy bombs.
New Food Expert reward - Points awarded for getting food and water.
Nuke Killer - Points awarded for killing enemies with a nuclear bomb.
Marksman – Points awarded for killing enemies with pee.
Iron head expert - Points awarded for killing enemies with farts.
Explosives expert - Points awarded for killing enemies with a bombs.
Adjusted the UI location.
Moved clothing choices to the in game mall.
Adjust the UI position after opening a room.
When you eat food, you now have a chance to double your resources.
Hand grenades can now detonate bombs already placed.
Bomb damage is reduced by up to 80 percent and the placement time has been decreased
Players who join in the middle of the game will have their armor packs strengthened according to the remaining time.
Microphone off by default.
Add new settings to the game. You can adjust sound effects, resolution, etc.
